evals.prompt: 给 1024x600 的 ESP32-P4 面板做一个中文倒计时 App，预设 1/5/10/30 分钟，开始/暂停/继续/重置，界面要干净，不要图片。
evals.expected_output: A FAT-only package: design brief + tokens + ASCII wireframe, launcher.json, scripts/main.lua, assets/countdown_cn.ttf; no SD dependency.
assertions: validate_app.py exits 0 with no sd_manifest.json
check_font_coverage.py exits 0 for all visible Chinese
launcher id matches the deployed directory
layout rows do not overlap and buttons are >=44 px
no lvgl.font_load path under /sdcard
runtime uses scr:load(), claw.abort_requested(), and lvgl.deinit()

evals.prompt: 做一个有画面的游戏主界面：余烬酒馆风格，全屏背景、角色立绘、标题、左右翻页和底部按钮。素材可以放 SD 卡。
evals.expected_output: A poster-style App with an L0 background, L1 sprite, L2 LVGL controls, optional L3 EAF; FAT fallbacks and sd_manifest.json; SD staging tree.
assertions: validate_app.py --sd-dir exits 0
sd_manifest entries have same-size fallbacks and valid kinds
package is <=300 KiB target or has a warning
image decoding uses image.load_file + set_raw_rgb565, not lvgl.image src
heavy art goes through panel-assets + image.load_file/set_frame; any LVGL file source uses D:/ or S:/ (Lottie is the only absolute /sdcard/... exception)
any L3 animation is a small local lottie/animimg/gif region (lottie src absolute /sdcard/... or src_data; animimg/gif D:/ or S:) and degrades gracefully when its asset is missing
launch without SD renders the fallback; launch with SD logs SD source

evals.prompt: 我拔掉 SD 卡后，应用不能黑屏，也不能崩溃；如果某张 SD 图损坏，只降级那一层。请给出实现和验证步骤。
evals.expected_output: A pcall-based asset resolver that tries SD, then same-size package fallback, then programmatic UI; logs one source line per layer.
assertions: every optional image/audio load is wrapped in pcall
fallback dimensions equal SD dimensions
no blank screen when /sdcard/panel-assets/<id> is absent
no retry loop for SD mount
verification covers no-SD, partial-SD, and corrupt-file states

evals.prompt: 在面板上做一个串口调试 App：用板载 RS485（UART1）收发数据，可以改波特率，界面上有接收区和发送框；打开/关闭串口不能卡界面，退出时要释放端口。
evals.expected_output: An App using require("uart") with uart.new(1, 26, 27, baud) inside pcall, one link at a time, a non-blocking read(512) poll (20-40 ms) that still calls lvgl.process_events, close() on stop/exit, and a TTF subset rebuilt for every Chinese string used.
assertions: uart.new uses port 1 and GPIO26/27 through pcall; a busy port shows an error instead of crashing the App
the main loop drains u:read(512) without a long timeout and still calls lvgl.process_events
u:close() runs on exit/abort and before reopening the port
baud/mode are validated, persisted, and the UI never busy-waits
check_font_coverage.py exits 0 for the final copy (the TTF was rebuilt, not a stale subset)

evals.prompt: 面板上做一个联网 App：连 MQTT 服务器，每 10 秒上报一次状态，订阅一个指令 topic，收到消息显示在屏幕上；断线要自动重连，界面不能卡。
evals.expected_output: An SD or FAT package using require("mqtt"): mqtt.new with uri/client_id from launcher args, connect() before subscribe/publish, a main loop that interleaves m:next_event(50) with lvgl.process_events(20), reconnect handling on disconnect, m:close() on exit, and a status label.
assertions: package starts with mqtt.new({uri=...}) where the URI comes from launcher.json args, not a hardcoded public broker
connect() is checked and subscribe/publish happen only after it returns true
the render loop calls m:next_event(50) together with lvgl.process_events(20)
disconnect/error events update the UI and a retry is scheduled (no busy loop)
m:close() runs on exit and validate_app.py exits 0
